## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; Energy, Healthcare and Consumer Staples are the only positive sectors while Technology and Financials show mixed internals. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — mixed signals confirm a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare leading on select names: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strength anchored by PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND and WMT (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Utilities showing weakness with CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and sector negative on the week. Consumer Discretionary soft with BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +8.57%) CORRECTION. Technology mixed but down on the week: SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style mixed, not a clear single-factor leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -8.94% | 1M: -9.42%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Communications, Utilities and parts of Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Largest 1W momentum: CSCO (1W: +22.41%), PANW (1W: +16.81%), OXY (1W: +12.43%). Major divergence flagged: several large caps (AMD, QCOM, INTC, BA) show 1W down but strong 1M gains — this is a MAJOR divergence; treat as tactical noise until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed internal picture: AAPL (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND, while QCOM (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +49.84%) CORRECTION and SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND. Sector is down on the week (1W -0.51%) — internal rotation between big-cap leaders and beaten-up names.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials soft on the week with JPM (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND, while V (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier. Sector breadth is negative; bank/credit sensitivity remains a headwind.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare showing select strength: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, offset by PFE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.34%) RECOVERY. Sector is marginally positive on the week and acting as a defensive/cyclical bridge.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Given NEUTRAL breadth and broad leadership, favor exposure to Energy and select Healthcare names (XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND in Tech and Utilities (SHOP, CEG). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; stay selective and monitor the large-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND for continuation. BEARISH: CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND despite bullish headlines, BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +5.82%) — follow earnings/news and oil moves; Healthcare (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -2.24%) on selective strength. BEARISH: Utilities and Consumer Discretionary (week negative) — watch for continued volatility in utilities around M&A/earnings headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above recent highs to confirm tech leadership; AAPL (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND holding weekly support would signal stability. XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND sustaining post-rally volume would confirm Energy continuation; CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND needs stabilization before considering re-entry.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
D (+90): NextEra deal chatter for Dominion — Utilities sector weak so this is a divergence to watch for catch-up. CEG (+85): strong Q1 and raised outlook but price BELOW TREND (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) — bullish news vs falling price indicates distribution/volatility. XOM (+70): cleared climate case and price confirming strength XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
BA (-60): headline risk on MAX issues aligns with price CORRECTION BA (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION — confirming risk. BKNG (-60): guidance cut and debt concerns with BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. UNH (-50): Berkshire exit headline but UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price diverge, monitor flows.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence among large caps (AMD, QCOM, INTC) and mixed news/price signals in Utilities (CEG) — watch for confirmed follow-through.
